display.purpose: The day-of-month numeral on the Hoy view only. The single largest element in the system.

body.purpose: Supporting prose: empty states, loading text, error messages.

label.purpose: Tab names, section headers, weekday line, button text, row date/time meta. Uppercase, tracked, tabular where numeric.

motion.name: tick-draw
motion.purpose: The one signature interaction: completing a task draws the checkmark stroke in, rather than popping or fading it.

components.name: Tab (active)
components.description: The current view's tab in the Hoy/Todas strip; visually attached to the page below it.
components.css: .ds-tab { position: relative; margin-bottom: -1px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-bottom: none; border-top-left-radius: 6px; border-top-right-radius: 6px; font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-tab-active { border-color: #d8cfb8; background: #f5f1e6; color: #1f1c18; z-index: 1; }

components.name: Tab (inactive)
components.description: A non-current tab; recessed one shade darker than the active page.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The 'Añadir' submit button — inverts like a stamp on hover rather than swapping to a tinted color.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 1px solid #1f1c18; border-radius: 2px; padding: 8px 16px; background: transparent; color: #1f1c18; font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1f1c18; color: #f5f1e6; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b5352a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Task Row
components.description: The signature component: a ledger line with a tick box, description, tabular time, and an always-visible delete mark. Shown here in its overdue, pending state.
components.html: • Enviar el reporte semanal12:47
components.css: .ds-task-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #d8cfb8; } .ds-tick { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 20px; height: 20px; flex-shrink: 0; border: 1px solid #b5352a; color: transparent; transition: color 0.15s, background-color 0.15s; } .ds-tick:hover, .ds-tick:focus-visible { background: #b5352a; color: #f5f1e6; } .ds-desc { flex: 1; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #1f1c18; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-when { flex-shrink: 0; font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; color: #b5352a; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-delete { flex-shrink: 0; color: #6b6255; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-delete:hover, .ds-delete:focus-visible { color: #b5352a; }

components.name: Text Input (ruled line)
components.description: The add-task description field — no box, a dashed ruled baseline waiting to be written on.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 1px dashed #96876c; padding: 8px 0; font-size: 1rem; color: #1f1c18; caret-color: #b5352a; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b6255; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-bottom-color: #1f1c18; }

narrative.overview: Agenda treats a due date as a page in a day planner, not a field in a form. Opening the app opens today's page: the huge tabular date numeral anchors the view, overdue items are stamped out in the one reserved red, and everything else reads as ruled ledger lines — a tick box, a description, a time, a way to strike it out. The system is deliberately flat and typographic: no cards, no shadows, no icon-as-decoration. Two direction rounds were considered and rejected in favor of this one — 'Courier Tracking Slip' (tasks as parcels in transit) and 'Manual Tab Rail' (a boxed-software reference manual) — both are documented in the direction contract at the top of frontend/src/layouts/Layout.astro for provenance. One deliberate revision happened after first ship: the page originally carried a continuous ruled-paper background texture. The user rejected it explicitly for reading as inconsistent with the row dividers, and asked instead for the page to read as a bordered sheet against a desk-toned backdrop. That is the current, intentional state.
keyCharacteristics: Flat cream 'page' bordered like a sheet, floating on a desk-toned backdrop (border only at ≥640px; full-bleed below it)
Every date and time numeral in tabular monospace; every other word in a workhorse system sans
Exactly one accent color (date-red), spent only on overdue/urgent/error meaning
State changes are marks (a drawn checkmark, a strikethrough), never a second hue
No shadows, no gradients, no glass

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Date-red appears nowhere except to mark overdue, urgent, or error state.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every date and every time numeral renders in the monospace stack with tabular figures — never the body sans.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow exists anywhere in this codebase. Depth comes from a 1px border and a background-color step, never from blur or offset shadow.

dos: Do reserve Date Red exclusively for overdue/urgent/error meaning — grep the codebase before adding a new use.
Do render every date and time value in the tabular monospace stack, never the body sans.
Do author icons as hand-drawn inline SVG at a consistent stroke weight; never a Unicode glyph standing in for an icon.
Do keep functional controls (delete, in particular) visible by default rather than hover-gated — the primary device has no hover.
Do show state changes as a written mark (a filled tick, a strikethrough) rather than a new color.
donts: Don't add a decorative background ruled-line texture behind page content — tried and explicitly rejected by the user.
Don't add box-shadow, glass, or blur anywhere.
Don't introduce a second accent color.
Don't use a kicker/eyebrow label above a heading.
